messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Furthermore, we checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Regarding your request for a cost breakdown, please understand that our internal cost structures are confidential and cannot be disclosed. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

Our main offer is a price of €5.98 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 12 months, no Preisgleitklausel. 

We appreciate your willingness to accelerate payment and have selected the 14-day payment package to provide our most competitive rate. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: a price of €5.89 per unit, a contract term of 12 months, no Preisgleitklausel.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
